note: Not a resume of yolov8s_v5_seed0_p2_20260819T114628 (see that run's manifest for why resume=True was abandoned). This is a fresh YOLO(...).train(...) call starting from that run's verified-good best.pt (epoch 15, mAP50-95=0.28423) used as an ordinary pretrained checkpoint: optimizer state, LR schedule, and warmup all reinitialize from scratch. provenance_caveat: Launched by an ad-hoc inline Python call during interactive debugging, not through scripts/train/train_detector.py's preflight harness -- no automatic git/environment snapshot was taken at launch time. This manifest was written after the fact from the run's own args.yaml and results.csv. Also affected by an unrelated Ultralytics relative-path quirk: passing project='runs/detect/research' resolved to a duplicated runs/detect/runs/detect/research/... save_dir instead of the expected path; root cause not fully diagnosed.
epoch_trend_note: mAP50-95 plateaus in the 0.310-0.321 range from epoch 9 onward (0.321, 0.316, 0.317, 0.310, 0.321, 0.316, 0.314); no clear further upward trend by epoch 15.
known_confounds: batch=2 instead of the baseline/NWD's batch=4, forced by VRAM (P2's extra stride-4 head increases activation memory); Ultralytics' nbs=64 gradient accumulation partially compensates but this is not held constant against baseline/NWD

P2's architectural rationale (adding a stride-4 head) was written with knowledge of the locked test's box-size distribution (median 16px), so any locked-test evaluation of this checkpoint is exploratory, not a blind confirmatory test -- same caveat as the NWD ablation
